newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends mostly up on late CBOT soy rally.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends mostly up on late CBOT soy rally.

text.p: WCE canola futures closed mostly higher on commercial and local buying precipitated by a late rally in CBOT soybeans, floor sources said.

They noted, however, gains were limited by the continued strength of the Canadian dollar, particularly against the yen, which was hurting export prospects. There was also moderate hedge selling pressure.

Business featured fairly active spread trading centered on July/November, May/November and March/May. Many were also squaring positions ahead of Friday's key USDA grain/oilseed reports. March canola closed $1.70 higher at $402.20.
Flaxseed finished mostly lower under pressure from commission house and hedge selling. March flaxseed finished steady at $354.00.
Feed wheat prices were higher with March higher boosted by concern about tight stocks. March ended up $0.40 at $173.80.
Western barley prices were lower on nearbys, largely reflecting weakness in CBOT corn. February closed off $1.10 at $135.70.
May feed peas closed up $0.50 at $192.00.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
